clauses.heading: EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
clauses.text:
EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
This Employment Agreement is made at Bengaluru on 12 August 2025 between
Vantage Systems India Private Limited, a company incorporated under the
Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at Whitefield, Bengaluru
(hereinafter "the Company"), and Ms. K. Raghavan, residing at HSR Layout,
Bengaluru (hereinafter "the Employee").
clauses.plain_english: A general provision of this contract.

clauses.heading: APPOINTMENT AND TERM
clauses.text:
1. APPOINTMENT AND TERM
The Company appoints the Employee as Product Manager with effect from
1 September 2025. This Agreement shall remain in force until terminated in
accordance with the provisions set out below.
clauses.plain_english: This clause covers APPOINTMENT AND TERM.

clauses.heading: REMUNERATION
clauses.text:
2. REMUNERATION
The Employee shall be paid a gross salary of Rs. 24,00,000 per annum, payable
monthly in arrears on or before the seventh day of the succeeding month,
subject to deduction of tax at source and other statutory deductions.

clauses.heading: PROBATION
clauses.text:
3. PROBATION
The Employee shall be on probation for a period of six months from the date of
joining. The Company may extend the probation period at its sole discretion.

clauses.heading: MINIMUM SERVICE PERIOD
clauses.text:
4. MINIMUM SERVICE PERIOD
The Employee shall serve the Company for a minimum service period of three
years from the date of joining. In the event the Employee resigns before the
completion of the said period, the Employee shall refund the training cost
incurred by the Company amounting to Rs. 3,00,000 together with all recruitment
expenses incurred in connection with the Employee's appointment.
clauses.plain_english: This clause covers MINIMUM SERVICE PERIOD.

findings.title: Employment bond or training-cost clawback

citations.note: A bond restraining the employee from leaving is a restraint of trade; courts uphold one only so far as it recovers actual, proven training expenditure.
Only reasonable compensation for actual loss is recoverable, whatever figure the bond names.

findings.plain_summary: You owe money if you leave before a fixed period.
findings.why_it_matters: The employer must prove what it actually spent on you. A round figure unconnected to real training cost is usually reduced or refused, but you may have to litigate to get there.

citations.note: A bond restraining the employee from leaving is a restraint of trade; courts uphold one only so far as it recovers actual, proven training expenditure.
Only reasonable compensation for actual loss is recoverable, whatever figure the bond names.

clauses.heading: TERMINATION
clauses.text:
5. TERMINATION
The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time without assigning any
reason by giving thirty days notice in writing. The Employee may resign only
after serving a notice period of ninety days, failing which the Employee shall
be liable to pay salary in lieu of the shortfall.

findings.title: Only one side can terminate at will
findings.matched_quote: Company may terminate this Agreement at any time without assigning any reason
findings.plain_summary: The other side can end this at any time, without a reason.
findings.why_it_matters: Check whether you have the same right on the same notice. An asymmetric termination right is the single most common one-sided term, and the easiest to get made mutual.

clauses.heading: CONFIDENTIALITY
clauses.text:
6. CONFIDENTIALITY
The Employee shall not disclose any Confidential Information of the Company to
any third party. The obligations of confidentiality under this clause shall
survive the termination of this Agreement in perpetuity and shall remain
binding upon the Employee for all time.

findings.title: Confidentiality lasting forever
findings.matched_quote: obligations of confidentiality under this clause shall survive the termination of this Agreement in perpetuity
findings.why_it_matters: Perpetual duties are hard to comply with years later when you no longer remember what was covered. Three to five years is the usual commercial norm, with genuine trade secrets carved out separately.

clauses.heading: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
clauses.text:
7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
The Employee hereby assigns to the Company all intellectual property,
inventions, designs and works created by the Employee during the term of
employment, whether or not such creation is related to the business of the
Company and whether or not created during working hours or using the resources
of the Company.

findings.title: Assignment of IP beyond the work itself
findings.matched_quote: all intellectual property, inventions, designs and works created by the Employee during the term of employment, whether or not such creation is related
findings.plain_summary: This may take ownership of work you did on your own time.
findings.why_it_matters: Narrow it to work actually made for this engagement, and attach a schedule listing anything you built beforehand that you want to keep.

clauses.heading: NON-COMPETITION
clauses.text:
8. NON-COMPETITION
The Employee shall not, for a period of twenty four months after the
termination of employment with the Company, directly or indirectly engage in,
be employed by, or render services to any competing business anywhere in India.

findings.title: Post-employment non-compete
findings.matched_quote: shall not, for a period of twenty four months after the termination of employment with the Company, directly or indirectly engage in, be employed by, or render services to any competing

citations.note: Every agreement restraining anyone from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business is void to that extent. Indian law has no 'reasonableness' exception for restraints operating after the contract ends.

findings.plain_summary: This stops you working for a competitor after you leave.
findings.why_it_matters: Under Indian law a restraint that bites after the contract ends is void, not merely hard to enforce. It can still be used to threaten you, and to withhold a relieving letter, so it is worth negotiating out even though a court is unlikely to uphold it.

citations.note: Every agreement restraining anyone from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business is void to that extent. Indian law has no 'reasonableness' exception for restraints operating after the contract ends.

clauses.heading: NON-SOLICITATION
clauses.text:
9. NON-SOLICITATION
The Employee shall not solicit any employee or customer of the Company for a
period of eighteen months following cessation of employment.

clauses.heading: DISPUTE RESOLUTION
clauses.text:
10. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be
referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator appointed by the Company,
whose decision shall be final and binding. The seat of arbitration shall be
Bengaluru.

findings.title: Arbitrator chosen by one side alone
findings.matched_quote: sole arbitrator appointed by the Company

citations.act: The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (Arbitration Act)
citations.note: A person whose relationship with a party falls in the Seventh Schedule is ineligible to act as arbitrator, and an ineligible person cannot validly appoint one either.

findings.plain_summary: The other side picks the person who decides your disputes.
findings.why_it_matters: A tribunal appointed unilaterally is open to challenge, so you could win the challenge and still have lost years. Insist on a jointly appointed arbitrator or an institutional appointment.

citations.act: The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (Arbitration Act)
citations.note: A person whose relationship with a party falls in the Seventh Schedule is ineligible to act as arbitrator, and an ineligible person cannot validly appoint one either.

clauses.heading: GOVERNING LAW
clauses.text:
11. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at
Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

consistency_issues.description: This contract states more than one notice period: thirty days notice (clause 5), notice period of ninety days (clause 5). Check whether they apply to different things, or whether one side simply has to give far more warning than the other.

redlines.title: Assignment of IP beyond the work itself
redlines.ask: Ask for the assignment to be narrowed to work actually made for this engagement, and attach a schedule of what you already own.
redlines.suggested_wording: The Employee assigns to the Company intellectual property created in the course of the Employee's duties and using Company resources. Material listed in Schedule [X], and anything created outside working hours without Company resources and unrelated to the Company's business, remains the property of the Employee.
redlines.fallback: At minimum ask to exclude work unrelated to the employer's business and created on your own time and equipment.

redlines.title: Employment bond or training-cost clawback
redlines.ask: Ask for the bond to be removed, or tied to training costs the employer can actually document.
redlines.suggested_wording: Where the Company has incurred certified external training expenditure on the Employee, the Employee shall on early resignation repay that documented expenditure, reduced proportionately for each completed month of service.
redlines.fallback: At minimum ask for the amount to reduce month by month over the bond period, and for the figure to be backed by receipts.

redlines.title: Post-employment non-compete
redlines.ask: Ask for this clause to be deleted, or cut back so that it only applies while you are still employed.
redlines.suggested_wording: The Employee shall not engage in any competing business during the subsistence of this Agreement. No restriction shall apply after the termination of employment.
redlines.fallback: If it will not be removed, ask for the period to be cut to six months, the geography limited to the specific city, and the restriction to name particular named competitors rather than any competing business.

redlines.title: Arbitrator chosen by one side alone
redlines.ask: Ask for the arbitrator to be appointed jointly, or by an arbitral institution.
redlines.suggested_wording: Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual written agreement of the parties, failing which by an arbitral institution agreed between them.
redlines.fallback: If they insist on appointing, ask for a panel of three with one appointee each and a jointly chosen presiding arbitrator.

redlines.title: Confidentiality lasting forever
redlines.ask: Ask for a fixed term, with genuine trade secrets handled separately.
redlines.suggested_wording: The obligations of confidentiality shall continue for three years after termination, save in respect of trade secrets, which shall continue for so long as they remain trade secrets.
redlines.fallback: If perpetual stays, ask for clear carve-outs for information that becomes public, is independently developed, or must be disclosed by law.

redlines.title: Only one side can terminate at will
redlines.ask: Ask for the termination right to be mutual, on the same notice.
redlines.suggested_wording: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other not less than sixty days prior written notice.
redlines.fallback: If they keep a shorter notice period, ask for a payment in lieu covering the difference.
